_comments: THE REFUND REQUEST HOOK (bc-aidp-next-golive#355). The ORDERS_REFUND_APPROVAL task type in
metadata/task-types/ names it as its OnComplete, OnCancel and OnReject action, so a decision made in
the Tasks inbox reaches the refund request. The class behind it holds no request logic and is idempotent.

fields.Name: Apply Refund Request Decision
fields.Description: Apply the outcome of a refund request's approval task to the request: an approval makes it Approved, so its requester may issue the refund; a rejection makes it Rejected; a task closed any other way withdraws it. Idempotent.
fields.UserPrompt: Apply the decision on a refund request approval task.

fields.Name: TaskID
fields.Description: The approval task whose outcome to apply. Tasks passes it when the task closes.
